input.command:
git add tests/cf-smoke/ package.json && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
test(cf-smoke): vitest suite exercising the live CF Worker

Suite at tests/cf-smoke/cf-smoke.spec.ts. Run via \`pnpm test:cf-smoke\`
against a live \`pnpm dev:cf\` instance.

Coverage (61 tests):
- Health + adapter/plugin meta routes
- Company-scoped read fan-out (agents, projects, issues, environments,
  live-runs, sidebar-badges, labels, skills, user-directory, etc.)
- Issue-scoped reads exercised twice when possible: once with the UUID,
  once with the human key (e.g. \"ALM-1\"). Specifically catches the
  \"invalid input syntax for type uuid\" regression.
- Agent-scoped reads (detail, configuration, runtime-state, etc.)
- Plugin-scoped reads with explicit assertions that /:pluginId and
  /:pluginId/dashboard never return 501 (regression guard).
- /_plugins/:pluginId/ui/index.js asserts response is NOT silently HTML
  (regression guard for the SPA fallback bug).
- Issue lifecycle: POST /api/companies/:id/issues, then re-reads against
  the new UUID to prove end-to-end mutation works.
- Project-scoped reads (only routes the server actually defines).

Pre-conditions documented in tests/cf-smoke/README.md: dev:cf running,
DEPLOYMENT_MODE=local_trusted, at least one company in the dev DB.

Currently asserts \`status < 500\` only (protects against worker crashes).
Doesn't validate response shapes — that's a follow-up.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
